ratios.quote: (ii) a Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio covenant of 3 :1, tested quarterly when Excess Availability is, for a specified period, less than the greater of 12.5 % of the Line Cap and $ 60 million)
As of December 31, 2025, QVC Group’s net leverage ratio, as calculated under the Credit Facility, was greater than 4.5 to 1.0.

parsed.notes: The Exit ABL 3.0x net leverage covenant is a springing test. It applies only when Excess Availability falls below the greater of 12.5% of the Line Cap and $60 million, and up to $500 million of unrestricted cash can be netted. No actual ratio is disclosed for 9/30/2026; the company says only that it was in compliance with all debt covenants. The facility was undrawn, with about $186 million of availability. The Exit ABL also has a minimum Excess Availability covenant equal to the greater of 10% of the Line Cap and $50 million. It is not listed here as a ratio. At 12/31/2025 the pre-emergence RCF net leverage ratio was only described as greater than 4.5x. That was a covenant breach, so the actual value is not given. That facility was later extinguished through the Chapter 11 emergence.
